cs.t: Steelcase cobi stool.  https://www.steelcase.com/products/office-chairs/cobi/  I like to work up high and transition from sitting to standing. The foot rest is a god-send for me. I'm pretty high-energy and fidget/shift throughout the day, so this chair is awesome. I would have bought a Herman Miller Aeron Stool, but I bought two Steelcase used for about $500 all-in.
